changelog:
Initial release of the Agent Starter Kit — streamlined setup for OpenClaw agents.

- Provides ready-to-use workspace structure including AGENTS.md, SOUL.md, HEARTBEAT.md, and memory system directories.
- Implements basic security practices such as credential permissions and secret scanning.
- Includes network discovery and agent registration via OADP integration.
- Sets up a proactive heartbeat for routine checks and network status.
- Offers a curated list of recommended skills for rapid next-step installations.
